lines: Take me forward, now that I know the reason I can become strong.
My heart stiffens, intoxicated by a mud‑splattered revolving lantern.
My trembling hand only wants to grasp something.
To the scent of night (I'll spend all thirty nights)
Even while glaring at the sky (Staring into the sky)
Only I can change myself, that's all.
Take me forward, now that I know the reason I can become strong.
No matter what!
Even the dream that cannot be erased, even the now that cannot stop.
If I can become strong for someone.
Thank you, sorrow.
Beaten by the world, I learned the meaning of defeat.
Crimson‑flame flower, bloom in full glory! Illuminate destiny.
The innabikari noise pierces the ears, a bewildered heart.
There are things that kindness alone cannot protect; I know that.
Beneath the surface, good and evil tangle, and divine punishment strikes the see‑through hypocrisy.
Tell me why, Tell me why, Tell me why, Tell me...
I don't need you!
A lone flower that kept challenging, blooming more beautiful than a rare talent.
Even a road violently paved with thorns.
It appears only to my earnest self, and I will overcome it.
Even the dream that was easily dismissed, that I couldn't protect.
Rooted in the crimson heart, residing in this blood.
A fragile, unnoticed ending that scatters away.
A merciless wind tears, a scream blowing.
A shadow of someone's laughter, a voice of someone's crying.
Everyone wishes for happiness.
No matter what!
Even the dream that cannot be erased, even the now that cannot stop.
If I can become strong for someone.
Thank you, sorrow.
Beaten by the world, I learned the meaning of defeat.
Crimson‑flame flower, bloom in full glory! Illuminate destiny.
Illuminate destiny.
